_doc: Weather locations. Gordon's file decides which spots are shown and in what order (its "locations" list of names, matched case-insensitively to `name` or `aliases`). Without that field, `default` is used. Coordinates always come from here. `lake`: counts for the Home Lake flag. `rc_field`: its RC rating is the fallback for the Home low-wind flying flag. Optional: `elevation_m` (sent to Open-Meteo so temps/wind are correct for that height), `snow` (fetch snowfall + snow depth and show them), `gordon_key` (per-day block in Gordon's file, e.g. brian_head: his skiing rating/note and low_wind are shown as-is), `gordon_info` (top-level note shown on the card).
